name: mirage
text: Four things, in order. (1) Best ParlayAPI key: done in v1.0.25 (releasing now): whatever order keys were typed, the engine and app ask the biggest paid plan first (your Pro key), then Starter, then free keys. (2) PBP stream as the default score source: built into the engine in v1.0.25. It reads ParlayAPI's live play-by-play stream (Pro key, NBA/NHL/MLB/NFL/NCAA), uses ITS score whenever it is ahead of ESPN's scoreboard and ESPN supplies the game clock and is the fallback when the stream is silent or has no match; the engine journals how many seconds the stream led ESPN, so we will have proof of whether it is better. Phone wiring and tennis come next (tennis has no match live right now; I need to see a real tennis frame before betting on it). (3) Full use of the docs: I read the whole API reference; so far used: Pro key first, live PBP, /arbitrage and /inplay/arbs as arb leads (next), consensus/line-movement (to judge from samples). (4) API monitor audit: I see the screenshot (Pinnacle shows green 'working' 6+0 with 300/300 requests and 'resets in 3m' although pinnapi is out of use and its keys are bad). I am auditing how each card's colour is decided and will make it: green only when a real call succeeded recently, yellow for slow or recently refused (auto-retrying in the background without touching scans), red for no connection or no credits, and off for an API that is switched off. Logged as CH48; I will report what I find.
